note: CLN3-associated isolated retinal degeneration (RP101) presents as a rod-cone dystrophy often featuring early macular changes or bull's-eye maculopathy.

evidence.text: In a cohort of 10 patients with isolated nonsyndromic retinal disease due to CLN3 mutations, patients exhibited rod-cone dystrophy with onset ranging from early to late, features of bull's-eye maculopathy or macular atrophy, and electroretinography revealing rod-cone dysfunction or undetectable responses.

source.title: Detailed Clinical Phenotype and Molecular Genetic Findings in CLN3-Associated Isolated Retinal Degeneration
source.quote: Electroretinography revealed a rod-cone pattern of dysfunction in 6 patients and were completely undetectable in 2 patients.

numbers.metric: patients with rod-cone pattern dysfunction on ERG

evidence.text: Among 15 patients harboring biallelic CLN3 variants with isolated retinal degeneration, two patterns of rod-cone degeneration were identified, including severe retinal degeneration with early macular atrophic changes.

source.title: Retinal Phenotype of Patients With Isolated Retinal Degeneration Due to CLN3 Pathogenic Variants in a French Retinitis Pigmentosa Cohort
source.quote: Two distinct patterns of retinal disease could be identified: a mild rod-cone degeneration of middle-age onset (n = 6; legal blindness threshold reached by 70s) and a severe retinal degeneration with early macular atrophic changes (n = 9; legal blindness threshold reached by 40s).
